Certification states enforced for the release ledgers; subsystem receipts adopt them through TGT-016.

Defaults are local (mock/loopback model); remote transmission requires explicit live mode, key and per-request allow_live; loopback-only enforcement for the local provider. Remote prompt fencing lands in M5.
Same residue as TGT-016.
All run actions use the approval-gated tool runtime; auto mode pre-approves only local, non-mutating tools; retries need fresh approval; approvals bind to immutable calls.
Container/signature/extension/MIME checks enforced; CSV header-location and preamble detection still assume the sniffed header row.
FULLY_WITHIN/TOUCH_ONLY/OUTSIDE/NULL_EMPTY/UNRESOLVED implemented for point-in-polygon; PARTIAL state absent (no polygon-polygon join).
Documents, archives, uploads and web snapshots are labelled UNTRUSTED_CONTENT; model output is never parsed for actions.
Provenance records attached to every ingested file and web snapshot; derived artifacts do not yet carry them (N04).
Structural citation checks exist; claim-level faithfulness absent.
Planning lives only in the Plan mode (PlanningGate removed); one settings home. No mechanical uniqueness check.
Wrapper opens system browser; no native window (RC-006).
Feed renders plans, actions, approvals, results, text, citations, artifacts, warnings and outcomes. OPEN: maps, tables and code-execution output in the feed (GIS/coding workspaces).
Sources/Memory/Settings exist; GIS/OCR/Code/Provenance/Artifacts surfaces absent.
Remote sensing, bathymetry and temporal GIS absent.
Tables/forms absent; OCR not wired into ingestion.
Live search needs BLK-WEB-001; prompt-injection resistance absent.

Loopback OpenAI-compatible provider with streaming, readiness probing and declarations (backends, hardware baseline, memory/storage, offline, limitations). OPEN: evaluation against a real local model on the declared Apple Silicon baseline (tests use a protocol-faithful fake server).

Credential-free work complete: remote use requires live mode + key + per-request allow_live, never implicit; the remote prompt uses the same fenced grounded prompt. Live remote evaluation needs an operator key.
Routing over declared locality, modalities, context size, permissions (allow_live), offline state and readiness; each run emits an inspectable route event with candidates, reasons and route_sha256.
Faithfulness/unsupported-claim metrics absent.
No declared format registry artifact.
Memory has no scope.
Permission-aware, audited (hash chain), attributable, cancellable before start, failure-aware. OPEN: feed-level observability (M3/M6) and model-initiated calls through the same gate.

All nine families have schemas and a registry; runtime enforcement at source, provenance, grant, tool call/audit, citation/answer trace, memory, routing and receipt boundaries. OPEN: runtime enforcement for execution_contract/run_manifest/agent_checkpoint/artifact_identity producers.
Data dir inside bundle (SD-006).

Conversation runs support restart (RUNNING->INTERRUPTED), resume of waiting runs after restart, cancel/stop, partial-failure recovery via targeted retry, and idempotent resubmission. App-level restart of the packaged app is MATRIX-016.

Every capability classified AVAILABLE_LOCALLY / UNAVAILABLE_OFFLINE / REQUIRES_REMOTE_SERVICE (plus LOCAL_DEPENDENCY_MISSING); remote providers ineligible when offline. OPEN: UI offline states and network-interruption tests (MATRIX-016).
No frozen performance thresholds.

Structural guarantees: tool calls only from the user's own message, approvals only from user decisions or the documented auto policy, fenced sources with unforgeable closing tags, prompts never include credentials, grants only via explicit grant. Detection is advisory (documented false positives) and never gates or triggers actions.

Covers path traversal, absolute/backslash paths, bombs (ratio + actual bytes), symlink/executable/encrypted members, malformed/truncated archives, extension/content mismatch, executable payloads. Scope: ZIP-family archives (zip, docx); tar/7z/rar are UNSUPPORTED and never extracted.
Secrets via environment only; no platform keychain.
Verification tooling exists; signing/notarization credentials unavailable (SIGNING_NOTARIZATION = BLOCKED).
Citation -> source manifestation, byte identity, parser/processor, trust, cited chunk, provenance record.
Traceable to source, chunk and chunk index; page-level location is available only where the parser records it.
Verified audit chain, per-action records behind disclosure.
Single settings surface: model (with readiness and remote consent), retrieval, token, offline capability view.
Run errors, warnings and tool results carry TGT-034 categories; plain API error payloads do not yet include a category.

Structured run events cover workflow transitions, tool calls, approvals, errors, routing and artifacts; tool audit is hash-chained. Source acquisition and permission changes are not yet in one event stream.
Declared behaviours verified in Chromium with zero axe violations; VoiceOver/WKWebView on macOS pending (M7).
Plan, route and JSON behind disclosure; permission, trust, provenance and failures are always visible (approval card, untrusted-content notice, error category).
GIS/OCR/coding extras are CLI-only, outside the governed tool registry.
Instruction-bearing source content verified inert; OPEN/CAPTURE/FREEZE/CITE covered by existing web tests. SEARCH needs BLK-WEB-001; COMPARE/SYNTHESIZE workflow benchmark not yet frozen.
Malformed, mislabeled, empty, truncated, encrypted, oversized, archive-attack and unsupported cases are covered; a declared format registry and a frozen benchmark receipt remain OPEN (TGT-012).

ALLOWED, DENIED, APPROVAL-REQUIRED, CANCELLED, TOOL ERROR, RESTART and DUPLICATE covered with audit truthfulness. OPEN: TIMEOUT (in-process handlers have no enforced timeout) and RETRY-of-failed-target flow (M3).
Local-only, remote allowed, remote forbidden, unavailable local, unavailable remote, modality mismatch, context constraint and offline state; no case violates permissions.

70 rendered checks pass (navigation, feed, progressive disclosure, settings, provenance, sources, error/loading/empty/offline-service states, keyboard). OPEN: GIS and OCR surfaces, and rendering on the supported macOS environment (WKWebView).
